# Vedara Care Polyclinic

> DHA-licensed polyclinic (DHA facility licence 2509266) in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Dubai, UAE, offering physiotherapy, Ayurveda, general practice (GP), dermatology and aesthetic treatments. One location only.

## Clinic facts
- Address: Binghatti Azure, Shop 4, Al Barsha South Fourth, Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Dubai, UAE — walking distance from Circle Mall
- Hours: daily 9:00am to 10:00pm
- Phone / WhatsApp: +971 55 573 6312
- Booking: https://vedaracare.ae/book/
- Insurance: reimbursement with all major insurers (patient pays; clinic provides documents). No direct billing.
- Prices: not published; ask on WhatsApp.
- Home healthcare (home physiotherapy, home doctor visits): coming soon, not yet available.
- Not offered: laser hair removal, hijama (wet cupping), cardiopulmonary rehabilitation.

- Stroke rehabilitation: https://vedaracare.ae/conditions/stroke-rehab-dubai/

- Sports injury physiotherapy: https://vedaracare.ae/physiotherapy/sports-injury-jvc/
